definitions.explanation: A work of visual art created by applying paint or other media to a surface.

examples.japanese: {絵画|かいが}{展|てん}を{見|み}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to see a painting exhibition.

examples.japanese: この{絵画|かいが}は19{世紀|せいき}の{作品|さくひん}だ。
examples.english: This painting is a 19th century work.

examples.japanese: {西洋|せいよう}{絵画|かいが}を{収集|しゅうしゅう}している。

notes:
{絵画|かいが} is a formal term for paintings and visual artwork.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {絵画|かいが}を{描|か}く (to paint a picture)
- {絵画|かいが}を{収集|しゅうしゅう}する (to collect paintings)
- {絵画|かいが}を{鑑賞|かんしょう}する (to appreciate paintings)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {絵画|かいが}{展|てん} (painting exhibition)
- {絵画|かいが}{教室|きょうしつ} (painting class)
- {油絵|あぶらえ}{絵画|かいが} (oil painting)

CATEGORIES:
- {西洋|せいよう}{絵画|かいが} (Western painting)
- {日本|にほん}{絵画|かいが} (Japanese painting)
- {抽象|ちゅうしょう}{絵画|かいが} (abstract painting)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {絵|え}: picture, painting (casual)
- {絵画|かいが}: painting (formal, art context)
- {画|が}: painting (in compounds)
